summary: Reproduced Pydantic bool_type rejection of strict=null in both ChatCompletionRequest and ResponsesRequest, then made only the two function-tool strict fields nullable while preserving the False default. Added regressions for both request shapes and independent omitted, true, and invalid structured-value boundaries. The same narrow change is present in still-open upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36199, but it was not present at the prepared base commit.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the change, both strict=null request shapes failed with bool_type at the reported field paths; omitted and boolean values were accepted. Raw output: reports/j-1ede4d271665/raw/baseline_protocol_validation.txt
Both complete OpenAI protocol test modules passed: 69 tests and 25 subtests. Raw output: reports/j-1ede4d271665/raw/pytest_protocol_after.txt

remaining_limitations: No live HTTP server/model-weight run was performed; reproduction and verification exercise the exact request models that reject the payload before model execution, not a full serving process.

GPU execution was not used because the defect and fix are confined to CPU-side Pydantic request validation before model execution; no GPU result is claimed, and a GPU smoke would not validate this behavior.
No model architecture, semantic accuracy, distributed workload, or GPU inference behavior was tested or claimed.
black, isort, and ruff were not installed in the prepared interpreter; git diff --check and the repository's protocol tests passed.
